app.name: RubricCheck QA
app.short_description: Flat-rate automated QA scoring and multimodal screenshot/PDF PII guardrail for Zendesk.
app.long_description:
RubricCheck QA brings affordable, flat-rate automated QA and real-time screenshot/PDF PII protection to SMB support teams of 5–40+ agents.

**Why teams switch to RubricCheck QA:**
- **No per-agent tax:** Flat per-account plans with unlimited agents (Free tier up to 100 tickets/month).
- **Multimodal Screenshot & PDF PII Guardrail:** Automatically scans attached images, screenshots, and PDFs for exposed credit cards, government IDs/passports, SSNs, API keys, and passwords — and lets agents permanently redact exposed files in one click using Zendesk's Comment Redaction API.
- **Custom QA Rubrics:** Combine 0–4 scale criteria with strict Yes/No compliance checks, auto-tag tickets (`rc_qa_pass`, `rc_qa_review`, `rc_pii_exposed`), and track team quality trends from the built-in Zendesk nav bar dashboard.
- **Privacy-First AI:** Powered by Google Gemini Decisions API on Paid Tier (zero model training on customer data) with strictly transient RAM-only attachment scanning and zero image storage.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Install RubricCheck QA from the Zendesk Marketplace.
2. Open the RubricCheck QA icon in your Zendesk left navigation bar.
3. Go to **Billing & Connection** and click **Connect Zendesk OAuth** to grant minimal granular permissions (`tickets:read`, `tickets:write`, `webhooks:read`, `webhooks:write`).
4. Customize your default QA rubric and PII Guardrail rules — every new attachment and solved ticket is now protected automatically.
